text:
emily: Quick PSA — final changelog sweep before v1.8.0 cutoff at 18:00 PT today. Please add one-liners to keep-a-changelog and ensure component tag and PR number are filled. If your PR is merged, add the entry to the PR or comment `add-changelog` on the PR and release-bot will prefill. ping owners for backports.

alex: Got it. Quick Q — how long should one-liners be? short sentence or 2? any tone preference?

tasha: Short sentence. Prefer imperative + component tag, e.g. "storage: improve cache eviction for small models (PR #1234)". No personal names. :+1:

emily: Exactly. Example template:
```
- component: short description (PR #)
```
Also include `severity:` tag when it's a breaking or behavioral change, e.g. `severity: non-breaking`.

jamal: I merged a hotfix to release/v1.8 yesterday — do I need a separate backport entry or just annotate the original PR?

emily: Annotate the original PR with `backport: release/v1.8` and add the one-liner there. Release-bot will fold it into the v1.8 changelog.

release-bot: Automation note: changelog-lint runs at cutoff+5m. Missing component or PR numbers will be flagged as `changelog/needs-info`. To opt out use `changelog: skip` on the PR.

ben: I'll do a sweep for my stack this afternoon and prefills where possible. Will ping if anything ambiguous.

tasha: FYI there's also a small script `scripts/prefill_changelog.py --pr 1234` in tools/ that generates the suggested blurb if the PR body follows the template.

alex: Thanks — I'll keep them concise. Doing PR 9876 now.

emily: Thanks team. If you can't make cutoff, add a comment to the release ticket /cc @emily and we'll triage manually. :rocket:

ben: done for my PRs. :white_check_mark:

tasha: added mine. :shipit:

alex: added. thanks!
